mapper.select: SELECT r.review_id AS reviewId, r.product_id AS productId, r.member_id AS memberId, r.rating, r.content, r.created_at AS createdAt, r.updated_at AS updatedAt, m.nickname FROM product_review r JOIN shop_member m ON r.member_id = m.member_id WHERE r.product_id = #{productId} ORDER BY r.review_id DESC
SELECT review_id AS reviewId, product_id AS productId, member_id AS memberId, rating, content, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM product_review WHERE review_id = #{reviewId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_review ( review_id, product_id, member_id, rating, content, created_at ) VALUES ( seq_product_review.NEXTVAL, #{productId}, #{memberId}, #{rating}, #{content}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN order_item oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.member_id = #{memberId} AND oi.product_id = #{productId} AND o.order_status != 'ORDER_CANCEL'
mapper.update: UPDATE product_review SET rating = #{rating}, content = #{content}, updated_at = SYSDATE WHERE review_id = #{reviewId} AND member_id = #{memberId}
